facts.fact: Repair terms after the breach in ch 20: tonight Neela will speak against Devan before the Company if she thinks him wrong, and at the gate tomorrow he will not answer for her. Devan tells her beforehand what he will say to the queen (he refused Kettamala alone; the Company has not voted; he will say nothing of what she is unless she does), and will stand a step behind her.
Corrects F905: Koman reports the long shape came into the river after the tower fell at the middle watch and watched the shelf until the stump stopped smoking. It took nothing.
